why: Defines the boundary between pricing.py, tax.py and invoice.py. tax.py only needs region, discount percent, and per-line category and amount. Team standard: cents as int, percent as number, unknown lookup raises KeyError; RULES.md says unknown customer pays 0% so None region is the explicit signal for that.

Tax rules round to the cent (half up). Float dollars cause binary rounding errors at exactly the half-cent boundary, e.g. 0.125 or 10.15*0.0825, so the tax total can differ by a cent between implementations. data_tax/rates.csv stores percents as numbers (8.25 = 8.25%). Proposal: money as int cents (1250 = $12.50), percent as number (10 = 10%). This matches the team standard. If you need dollars for display, convert only at render time in invoice.py. The tax.api proposal depends on this, so I will hold until it is settled.

Accept agent1 v1 with tax owning all rounding: tax.py converts dollars to Decimal via repr (no binary float error), applies half-up to the cent, and percent rates from rates.csv. I withdraw my objection.
